async function obtainSixRawCopper(bot) {
    // The function checks if the bot already possesses at least six raw copper items; if so, it stops. Otherwise, it attempts to find and equip either a stone or wooden pickaxe. It first searches for nearby copper ore blocks and mines as many as needed up to the required amount. If not enough are found, it explores the area until copper ore is located. Finally, it equips a pickaxe again and mines the remaining required amount of copper ore.
}
